correctness.rationale: The normalized diagonal monomial norm follows exactly from planar area plus a positive radial probability measure: π^{-1}||z^n||²=1/(n+1)+κm_n, m_n=E|z|^{2n}. Therefore πK(t)=∑(n+1)t^n/[1+κ(n+1)m_n]. Subtracting (1−t)^{-2} and treating n=0 separately yields the rank-one limit G=(1−t)^2πK=1−[κ/(1+κ)](1−t)^2+O_M(ρ²), uniformly for |t|≤1+η with first t and κ derivatives: m_n≤ρ^{2n} bounds the remaining series. For κ>0 the reference zeros are 1±sqrt((1+κ)/κ); the negative root crosses t=−1 at κ=1/3, is simple and has dt/dκ=9/4. Choose disjoint neighborhoods of the crossing and the compact remaining κ ranges; holomorphic Rouché/implicit-function control gives a unique real negative zero above the unique crossing, no interior zeros below it, and no other scalar zero for fixed M>1/3 and sufficiently small ρ. The boundary equation at t=−1 equals 1/4−κ/(1+κ)+4κm1−8κ²m1²−9κm2+O_M(ρ^6); solving gives κc=1/3+(64/27)m1+(4736/243)m1²−(16/3)m2+O_M(ρ^6). For uniform disk, m1=ρ²/2,m2=ρ^4/3 gives 32/27 and 752/243. The theorem is only for positive radial measures, κ∈[0,M] fixed finite and ρ sufficiently small: numerical contour checks neither prove global zero absence nor control unbounded M.

value.rationale: A sharp zero/no-zero boundary of reproducing kernels under localized positive mass is a natural stability invariant of weighted Bergman spaces, not an arbitrary perturbation. Classifying every radial profile, including singular circles, proving exact one-simple-negative-root behavior, and computing the first two universal moment corrections to the onset resolves a worthwhile analytic question beyond a known one-off counterexample or the trivial point-mass limit. A future researcher studying Lu Qi-Keng zeros and singular radial perturbations could use this exact controlled threshold; the theorem does not claim arbitrary weights/nonradial distributions.

limitations: Requires a fixed finite M>1/3 and profile-uniform sufficiently small radius ρ_M; no unbounded-mass or nonradial claim.
The independently computed 12 contour counts and symbolic coefficient match are bounded corroboration only.
Older unindexed kernel-perturbation priority remains uncertain.
